wifi.instructions: Connect to the 'GuestNetwork' WiFi network using the password provided. The network is available throughout the property.
troubleshooting: If you can't find the network, try refreshing your device's WiFi list
Make sure you're entering the password correctly (case-sensitive)
If issues persist, try restarting your device's WiFi connection

rules: No parties or events without prior approval
Respect quiet hours from 10 PM to 7 AM
Keep the property clean and tidy
Report any damages or issues immediately
houseRules.smokingPolicy: Smoking is not allowed inside the property. Smoking is permitted in designated outdoor areas only.
outdoorGuidelines: Follow fire safety guidelines when using outdoor fire features

indoor.content: The home features 5 bedrooms and 5 bathrooms spread across 2,738 square feet. The interior is filled with natural light and offers a warm, comfortable layout perfect for family life, entertaining, or quiet retreat.

outdoor.content: Set on 8.4 peaceful acres, the property offers wide-open skies, mature trees, and an abundance of natural surroundings that create a tranquil setting. There's plenty of room to spread out, whether you envision walking trails, a garden, or simply relaxing on the porch while taking in the Hill Country sunsets.

pool.content: The property features a beautiful pool perfect for cooling off during hot Texas days. The pool area includes comfortable seating and is surrounded by the natural beauty of the Hill Country.
pool.location: The pool is located in the backyard area, easily accessible from the main house.

limo.content: A limo is included with the property rental. Please see the how-to guide for details on accessing and using the limo.
limo.access: The limo is parked on the property. Keys and access instructions are provided in the welcome packet.
guidelines: Return the limo in the same condition
Contact host if any issues arise

sunsets.bestTimes: Evening hours, approximately 30 minutes before sunset
sunsets.tips: The Hill Country sunsets are spectacular. Find a comfortable spot on the porch or deck, bring a camera, and enjoy the natural beauty.
sunsets.photography: The property offers excellent photography opportunities, especially during golden hour. The wide-open skies and natural landscape create stunning backdrops.

howToGuides.title: A/C & Heating

steps.title: Locate the thermostat
steps.description: The thermostat is located in the main living area on the wall.

steps.title: Adjust temperature
steps.description: Use the up/down arrows to set your desired temperature. The system will automatically maintain this temperature.

steps.title: Set mode
steps.description: Select 'Cool' for air conditioning or 'Heat' for heating. The 'Auto' mode will automatically switch between cooling and heating as needed.

troubleshooting: If the system doesn't turn on, check that the thermostat is set correctly
If the temperature doesn't change, wait a few minutes for the system to respond
If issues persist, contact the host

steps.title: Pool access
steps.description: The pool is located in the backyard and is accessible from the main house.

steps.title: Pool safety
steps.description: Please follow all pool safety guidelines. Children should be supervised at all times.

steps.title: Pool maintenance
steps.description: The pool is maintained regularly. If you notice any issues, please contact the host immediately.

howToGuides.title: Hot Tub

steps.title: Locate the hot tub
steps.description: The hot tub is located in the outdoor area. It's easily accessible from the main house.

steps.title: Check temperature
steps.description: The hot tub should be pre-heated. Check the temperature display to ensure it's at your desired setting (typically 100-104°F).

steps.title: Enter safely
steps.description: Use the steps or ladder to enter the hot tub. Be careful as surfaces may be slippery when wet.

steps.title: Adjust settings
steps.description: Use the control panel to adjust jets, temperature, and lighting as desired. The controls are located on the side of the hot tub.

steps.title: Enjoy responsibly
steps.description: Limit your time in the hot tub to 15-20 minutes at a time. Stay hydrated and exit if you feel dizzy or uncomfortable.

steps.title: When finished
steps.description: Turn off jets and lights when finished. Close the cover securely to maintain temperature and keep debris out.

safety: Never use the hot tub alone
Supervise children at all times - children under 5 should not use the hot tub
Limit time to 15-20 minutes to avoid overheating
Stay hydrated - drink water before and after use
Do not use if you are pregnant, have heart conditions, or are under the influence of alcohol
Exit immediately if you feel dizzy, nauseous, or uncomfortable
Keep the cover closed when not in use
troubleshooting: If the hot tub is not heating, check that the power is on and the temperature is set correctly
If jets are not working, check the control panel settings and ensure the pump is running
If the water appears cloudy or has an unusual odor, do not use and contact the host immediately
If the control panel is not responding, try turning the power off and on again
If you notice any leaks or damage, contact the host immediately

howToGuides.title: TV & Streaming

steps.title: Turn on the TV
steps.description: Use the TV remote to turn on the television. The TV is located in the main living area.

steps.title: Select input source
steps.description: Use the input/source button on the remote to select the correct input (HDMI 1, HDMI 2, etc.) for your streaming device.

steps.title: Connect to streaming device
steps.description: If using a streaming device (Roku, Apple TV, Fire Stick, etc.), ensure it's connected to an HDMI port and powered on.

steps.title: Connect to WiFi
steps.description: Use the WiFi password provided in the guidebook to connect your streaming device to the GuestNetwork.

steps.title: Launch streaming apps
steps.description: Navigate to your preferred streaming service (Netflix, Hulu, Disney+, etc.) and sign in with your account.

steps.title: Adjust volume and settings
steps.description: Use the TV remote to adjust volume, picture settings, and other preferences as needed.

troubleshooting: If the TV won't turn on, check that it's plugged in and the power outlet is working
If there's no picture, check the input source and ensure cables are connected properly
If streaming is slow or buffering, check your WiFi connection and try moving closer to the router
If the remote isn't working, check the batteries and ensure you're pointing it at the TV
If you can't find a streaming app, check the app store on your streaming device
If audio isn't working, check the TV volume and ensure the correct audio output is selected
If issues persist, try unplugging the TV and streaming device for 30 seconds, then plugging back in

howToGuides.title: Appliances

steps.title: Kitchen appliances overview
steps.description: The kitchen is fully equipped with modern appliances including a refrigerator, stove, oven, microwave, dishwasher, and coffee maker.

steps.title: Refrigerator
steps.description: The refrigerator is located in the kitchen. Adjust the temperature settings as needed using the control panel inside.

steps.title: Stove and oven
steps.description: The gas/electric stove and oven are ready to use. Turn the knobs to light the burners or set the oven temperature. The oven may need to preheat before use.

steps.title: Microwave
steps.description: The microwave is located above or near the stove. Use the keypad to set time and power level. Press start to begin heating.

steps.title: Dishwasher
steps.description: Load dishes in the dishwasher, add detergent to the dispenser, select the appropriate cycle (normal, heavy, light), and press start. The dishwasher will run automatically.

steps.title: Coffee maker
steps.description: Fill the water reservoir, add coffee grounds to the filter, place the carafe, and press the brew button. The coffee maker will automatically stop when finished.

steps.title: Washing machine and dryer
steps.description: If available, the washing machine and dryer are located in the laundry area. Follow the instructions on the machines for loading, selecting cycles, and adding detergent.

troubleshooting: If an appliance won't turn on, check that it's plugged in and the circuit breaker hasn't tripped
If the refrigerator isn't cooling, check the temperature settings and ensure the door is closed properly
If the stove won't light, check that the gas is on (if gas stove) or that the power is connected (if electric)
If the microwave isn't working, check that the door is closed securely and the timer is set correctly
If the dishwasher isn't cleaning properly, check that detergent was added and the cycle was selected correctly
If the coffee maker isn't brewing, check that water was added and the filter basket is in place
If any appliance is making unusual noises or not functioning properly, stop using it and contact the host immediately

howToGuides.title: Limo

steps.title: Locate the limo
steps.description: The limo is parked on the property. Keys and access instructions are in the welcome packet.

steps.title: Check the limo
steps.description: Before using, check that the limo is in good condition and has fuel.

steps.title: Use responsibly
steps.description: Use the limo responsibly and follow all traffic laws. Return it in the same condition.

troubleshooting: If the limo doesn't start, check the battery and fuel levels
If you notice any issues, contact the host immediately
In case of emergency, use the provided emergency contact information
